decisions.reason: The charting bundle was publicly launched with several rapid releases and is part of the committed map.apps ecosystem, so management will keep it despite its lack of visibility since 2019, attributing that to normal maturation.
VueTOC was a small experimental component announced only once, with no visible presence since, so little commitment remains to justify it and its functionality can be folded into the main platform.
The GIS platform is the flagship product line central to the firm's announced direction, and heavy investment and public commitment make withdrawal very unlikely.
Mobile field data capture fits the core enterprise geospatial offer and had a dedicated page, so management will attribute weak visibility to temporary adoption delays and persist with it.

The search extension is tied to the committed web map platform and had its own page, so it will be kept, though its overlap with the already-dropped search plugin (Product B) raises the risk of consolidation.
